governance.anti_ladder_rule: DO NOT assert Axiomatter < Hyperverity < Transboundless < Nullinfinity < Omniprecedent. No universal five-term scalar ordering is established.
governance.normalization_note: Primary wording is preserved verbatim. Typed normalization is an interpretive publication layer and does not rewrite source text.

entries.source_definition: Physical manifestation of pure indisputable truth where raw strength is not measured in weight but in the sovereign reality of the action itself.
entries.normalized_definition: A physical manifestation of pure indisputable truth, with operative physicality grounded in the sovereign reality of the action rather than ordinary weight, mass, or energy measurements.
guards: Never automatically render as an AP, mass, or tier magnitude.
Represents sovereign reality over conventional physics, not an arithmetic power level.
valid_usage_requirements: Must describe an action or substance operating via indisputable truth manifestation.

entries.source_definition: A classification for narrative statements where a spoken absolute truth forcefully and permanently overwrites the existing mechanical logic of the entire universe.
entries.normalized_definition: A qualifying absolute statement or proposition P that permanently overwrites the relevant mechanical logic of the universe.
guards: Not a generic aura, state, durability tier, or AP rating without the qualifying statement and overwrite structure.
Formal typing requires identifiable proposition P and explicit overwrite relation.
valid_usage_requirements: Must specify the qualifying statement P or note that the statement constructor is unstated in source.

entries.source_definition: A state of capacity and volume that instantly outgrows any conceptual container or logical boundary the exact microsecond someone tries to measure it.
entries.normalized_definition: A capacity or volume property where attempted conceptual containment, logical bounding, or measurement causes property q to outgrow the attempted bound immediately.
guards: Reactive property triggered by attempted bounding/measurement, not automatically static inaccessibility or Bdl-strength 0.
Cannot be mapped to Inaccessible Cardinals H > Cl(L) without rigorous 5-condition bridgeproof.
valid_usage_requirements: Must identify entity X and property/quantity q to which the reactive outgrowth applies.

entries.source_definition: A mathematical and conceptual measurement describing a power gap so staggeringly massive that standard maximum limits and impossibilities are instantly reduced to absolute zero.
entries.normalized_definition: A comparative superiority-gap metric between comparator A and comparator B across domain d, where standard maximum limits and impossibilities are reduced to zero relative to the superior term.
guards: Strictly a relational gap metric; prohibited from being rendered as a unary power tier, field, or barrier.
Preserve Nullfinity as historical source spelling without asserting an unproven canon identity theorem.
valid_usage_requirements: Must specify comparator A, baseline comparator B, and domain d where recoverable.

entries.source_definition: A supreme scaling metric where an Arthitean does not just break a universal rule but retroactively becomes the fundamental reason that rule was ever created.
entries.normalized_definition: A relation where entity X retroactively becomes the fundamental teleological reason rule R was ever established.
guards: Target rule R must be specifically identified; generic Omniprecedent cognition, durability, or strength is under-typed without that relation.
Does not establish raw physical superiority over arbitrary unruled domains.
valid_usage_requirements: Must identify entity X and specific rule R that retroactively derived from X.
